articles.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will continue extending range of strikes on Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine will continue to increase the range of its strikes within Russia. Zelenskyy underscored this strategy by sharing footage of a long-range attack. This declaration signals Ukraine's resolve to escalate its offensive capabilities and pressure Russian targets, marking a critical development in the ongoing international conflict between the two nations.

articles.title: Russia says it's scaling down WW2 victory parade due to Ukrainian threat
articles.summary: Russia's Kremlin announced a significantly scaled-back Victory Day parade for World War Two celebrations. This year, the traditional display of military weaponry will be omitted, a departure attributed to increased security threats. While major cities like Moscow will proceed, regions bordering Ukraine have cancelled their events, highlighting ongoing geopolitical tensions and the conflict's impact.

articles.title: Ukraine says it hits Russian oil pumping station 1,500 km away
articles.summary: Ukraine conducted a drone strike 1,500 km deep into Russia, hitting an oil pumping station near the Ural Mountains. President Zelenskiy affirmed Kyiv's plan to escalate such strikes, signaling a significant escalation of the conflict. This strategy aims to disrupt Russian infrastructure far from the frontlines, impacting its war efforts and increasing regional tensions.

articles.title: Scared Putin axes tanks and military hardware from annual WW2 parade over fears Ukraine could attack
articles.summary: President Putin has decided to exclude tanks and heavy military hardware from Russia's upcoming May 9 Victory Day parade in Red Square. This move, reportedly due to concerns over potential Ukrainian attacks, highlights the ongoing strain on Russian military resources amid the conflict. The decision reflects a prioritization of operational forces over traditional ceremonial displays, signaling the current state of Russia's military focus.

articles.title: Russia scales back Moscow Victory Day parade, blaming threat from Ukraine
articles.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry announced its annual military parade, stating it will feature representatives from all branches of Russia's armed forces. The parade is also set to include a colourful fly-past, showcasing its air power. This event underscores Russia's military readiness and tradition, often serving as a display of national strength and technological prowess.

articles.title: Rosatom enters Indian market of additive manufacturing
articles.summary: Russia's Rosatom has supplied its RusBeam 2800 industrial 3D printer to India, significantly enhancing the nation's additive manufacturing capabilities. This delivery strengthens technological collaboration between Russia and India. Rosatom, primarily a nuclear major, is actively expanding its advanced manufacturing business, providing India access to cutting-edge industrial technology crucial for various strategic sectors.
